/**
 * @name ClearVision
 * @author ClearVision Team
 * @version 6.9.0
 * @description Highly customizable theme for BetterDiscord.
 * @source https://github.com/ClearVision/ClearVision-v6
 * @website https://clearvision.github.io
 * @invite dHaSxn3
 */

/* Credits to Zerthox for making the original theme. */

/* SETTINGS */
:root {
  /* ACCENT COLORS */
  --main-color: #2780e6; /* main accent color */
  --hover-color: #1e63b3; /* hover accent color */
  --success-color: #43b581; /* success accent color */
  --danger-color: #982929; /* danger accent color */
  --url-color: var(--main-color); /* URL link color */

  /* STATUS COLORS */
  --online-color: #43b581; /* online status color */
  --idle-color: #faa61a; /* idle status color */
  --dnd-color: #982929; /* do not disturb status color */
  --streaming-color: #593695; /* streaming status color */
  --offline-color: #808080; /* offline status color */

  /* GENERAL */
  --main-font: gg sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; /* main font */
  --code-font: Consolas, Liberation Mono, Menlo, Courier, monospace; /* font for codeblocks */
  --text-normal: rgb(220, 221, 222); /* normal text color */
  --text-muted: rgb(114, 118, 125); /* muted text color */
  --channels-width: 220px; /* channel list width */
  --members-width: 240px; /* member list width */
  --server-unread: var(--main-color); /* color of the icon for servers with unread messages */

  /* APP BACKGROUND */
  --background-shading: 100%; /* app background shading */
  --background-overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); /* app background overlay */
  --background-image: url(https://clearvision.github.io/images/sapphire.jpg); /* app background image */
  --background-position: center; /* app background position */
  --background-size: cover; /* app background size */
  --background-repeat: no-repeat; /* app background repeat */
  --background-attachment: fixed; /* app background attachment */
  --background-brightness: 100%; /* app background brightness */
  --background-contrast: 100%; /* app background contrast */
  --background-saturation: 100%; /* app background saturation */
  --background-invert: 0%; /* app background invert */
  --background-grayscale: 0%; /* app background grayscale */
  --background-sepia: 0%; /* app background sepia */
  --background-blur: 0px; /* app background blur */

  /* HOME BUTTON ICON */
  --home-icon: url(https://clearvision.github.io/icons/discord.svg); /* home button icon */
  --home-position: center; /* home button icon position */
  --home-size: 40px; /* home button icon size */

  /* CHANNEL COLORS */
  --channel-unread: var(--main-color); /* Unread Server channel color */
  --channel-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); /* Read Server channel color */
  --channel-text-selected: #fff; /* Selected channel text color */
  --muted-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); /* Muted channel color */

  /* MODAL BACKDROP */
  --backdrop-overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); /* modal backdrop overlay */
  --backdrop-image: var(--background-image); /* modal backdrop image */
  --backdrop-position: var(--background-position); /* modal backdrop position */
  --backdrop-size: var(--background-size); /* modal backdrop size */
  --backdrop-repeat: var(--background-repeat); /* modal backdrop repeat */
  --backdrop-attachment: var(--background-attachment); /* modal backdrop attachment */
  --backdrop-brightness: var(--background-brightness); /* modal backdrop brightness */
  --backdrop-contrast: var(--background-contrast); /* modal backdrop contrast */
  --backdrop-saturation: var(--background-saturation); /* modal backdrop saturation */
  --backdrop-invert: var(--background-invert); /* modal backdrop invert */
  --backdrop-grayscale: var(--background-grayscale); /* modal backdrop grayscale */
  --backdrop-sepia: var(--background-sepia); /* modal backdrop sepia */
  --backdrop-blur: var(--background-blur); /* modal backdrop blur */

  /* USER POPOUT BACKGROUND */
  --user-popout-image: var(--background-image); /* user popout background image */
  --user-popout-position: var(--background-position); /* user popout background position */
  --user-popout-size: var(--background-size); /* user popout background size */
  --user-popout-repeat: var(--background-repeat); /* user popout background repeat */
  --user-popout-attachment: var(--background-attachment); /* user popout background attachment */
  --user-popout-brightness: var(--background-brightness); /* user popout background brightness */
  --user-popout-contrast: var(--background-contrast); /* user popout background contrast */
  --user-popout-saturation: var(--background-saturation); /* user popout background saturation */
  --user-popout-invert: var(--background-invert); /* user popout background invert */
  --user-popout-grayscale: var(--background-grayscale); /* user popout background grayscale */
  --user-popout-sepia: var(--background-sepia); /* user popout background sepia */
  --user-popout-blur: calc(var(--background-blur) + 3px); /* user popout background blur */
  --user-popout-overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); /* user popout overlay color */

  /* USER MODAL BACKGROUND */
  --user-modal-image: var(--background-image); /* user modal background image */
  --user-modal-position: var(--background-position); /* user modal background position */
  --user-modal-size: var(--background-size); /* user modal background size */
  --user-modal-repeat: var(--background-repeat); /* user modal background repeat */
  --user-modal-attachment: var(--background-attachment); /* user modal background attachment */
  --user-modal-brightness: var(--background-brightness); /* user modal background brightness */
  --user-modal-contrast: var(--background-contrast); /* user modal background contrast */
  --user-modal-saturation: var(--background-saturation); /* user modal background saturation */
  --user-modal-invert: var(--background-invert); /* user modal background invert */
  --user-modal-grayscale: var(--background-grayscale); /* user modal background grayscale */
  --user-modal-sepia: var(--background-sepia); /* user modal background sepia */
  --user-modal-blur: calc(var(--background-blur) + 3px); /* user modal background blur */

  /* THEME BD COLORS */
  --bd-blue: var(--main-color); /* BetterDiscord main color */
  --bd-blue-hover: var(--hover-color); /* BetterDiscord hover color */
  --bd-blue-active: var(--hover-color); /* BetterDiscord active color */
}

/* Additional styling for elements can be added here */
